subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Dinner
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming Annual Employee Appreciation Dinner scheduled for Friday, December 10th, 2021. The event will be held at the Grand Ballroom of the Luxe Hotel and will include dinner, awards ceremony, and entertainment. Please RSVP by November 30th to confirm your attendance. We look forward to celebrating together! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
